title: Eleven Minutes Before the Door
subtitle: 自信与心态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自信与心态（人与自我·自信与心理健康）
meta: 主题语境：自信与心态（人与自我·自信与心理健康）　|　核心词汇：confidence　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 confidence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my sister ① lost her confidence eleven minutes before a door she had to open, and she said the losing was the whole of the morning. The ② confidence, meaning the sureness and not the knowledge, came back at the stair and stayed; confidence, she said, is the only thing in a corridor that is judged by how quickly it returns.

Every ③ confidence in that house had the same stair, and the ④ confidence at the end, meaning the one she kept for the interviews and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever borrowed twice. Confidence, my mother said, is nine parts returning and one part somebody willing to walk up; my sister said the walking up is the part that fills the corridor.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ a confidence was the whole of the letter, meaning the secret and not the sureness. The ⑥ confidence, meaning the secret and not any of that, is the only thing in a letter that everybody keeps and nobody repeats; confidence, he said, is either something you lose or the only word that means both a sureness and a secret. She said the secret is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ confidence had become a line in a reference, and the reference had become an argument about the stair. The ⑧ confidence of the whole thing, my sister wrote in April, was one door and thirty years of returning; confidence, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to walk up. He said the walking up was never mentioned.

The ⑨ confidence I remember is the one at the end, which she found in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ confidence, my mother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being kept; every confidence, she said, is a sureness that has agreed to look like a secret. She said the sureness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 自信（指那种笃定本身，与那些知识相对）
C. 固定搭配：lose one's confidence 失去信心
D. n. 自信（指那栋房子里每一次）
E. n. 自信（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 秘密；知心话（a confidence，指被告知的秘密）
G. n. 信心（指推荐信里提到的那一项）
H. n. 信任；信赖（抽象总称）

items.q: lost her confidence eleven minutes before a door
The confidence, meaning the sureness and not the knowledge
a confidence was the whole of the letter
the confidence had become a line in a reference
The confidence of the whole thing
A confidence, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: lose one's confidence 意为“失去信心”，1966 年姐姐在一扇她必须推开的门前十一分钟失去了信心。
confidence 意为“自信”，指那种笃定本身而不是那些知识，它到楼梯口才回来，并且留住了。
confidence 指那栋房子里每一次信心，每一次都在同一道楼梯上回来。
confidence 指末尾那一次（她留给面试的那一种），是唯一有人借过两次的。
a confidence 意为“秘密、知心话”，父亲说那句知心话就是那封信的全部，指的是那个秘密而不是那种笃定。
confidence 为另一个义项，指被告知的秘密而不是那种笃定，是信里人人都守住、却无人复述的东西。
confidence 意为“信心”，指推荐信里提到的那一项，到 1974 年这种信心成了推荐信里的一行。
confidence 意为“信任、信赖”，姐姐四月写道，整件事的信赖是一扇门三十年的回来。
confidence 意为“自信、信心”，我记得的是末尾那一次，她 1980 年找回的，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
confidence 为抽象总称，母亲说一份信赖是唯一会因为被守住而变好的东西。
